question: Which additional exact item-specific and common reductions occur inside BuildingWonderProductionCostLookup after its accepted signed factor multiplication?

scope.boundary: This packet follows the remainder of one exact cost helper and records reduction gates and arithmetic. A bounded follow-up checks one exact scalar load form for the 0x82FFE7C8 input outside the helper. The conditional authored scenario source for 0x830E8FFE does not establish a complete producer inventory, actual scenario selection, live retention or complete gameplay policy for that gate. This packet does not establish the meanings or writers of 0x82FFE7C8 or other neutral fields, caller-side cost parity, validity of uninitialized record IDs, production completion or runtime execution of these branches.

acceptedInputs.building: For item IDs 100 through 199, signed record byte +0x41 is multiplied by the current scalar and joins the common reduction path.
acceptedInputs.wonder: For item IDs 200 through 299, signed record halfword +0x40 is multiplied by the current scalar and joins the common reduction path.
acceptedInputs.scalar: The helper starts its scalar at ten and subtracts a positive signed player-indexed halfword from 0x830E9050 before either record-factor multiplication.
acceptedInputs.qualification: The address ranges are cost-helper routing ranges, not initialized-definition validation. Multiplication and shifts use guest 32-bit arithmetic. Before the item-specific tests and common Wonder scaling, the helper forms its mask by shifting literal one by itemId minus 100 with native word-shift semantics. Among initialized records, Wonder 229 shares Barracks mask 0x00000002 and Wonder 233 shares Library mask 0x00000020. These select the UEA 19 and UEA 20 tests respectively; 233 also matches the later three-quarter subtraction gate. The mutually exclusive mask tests do not establish production eligibility.

currentEvidence.method: One exact-function generated-code window identified the remaining branch conditions and arithmetic; one foreground read-only Ghidra raw-word query covered the two adjoining late-function windows. A bounded exact-scalar load/store search found one function-owned 0xE7C8 use outside the cost helper, followed by exact-function and raw-word windows to verify its base and local branch. Previously accepted packets supply the earlier item factors and UEA branches. Additional selected current-image words at 0x82CF1330 through 0x82CF1340 and narrow exact-function generated corroboration establish the literal-one word-shift mask used by the item-specific tests before common Wonder scaling.

entries.result: Exact guest words corroborate item masks, UEA ID 21 call, two neutral word-and-halfword equality gates, and the half and third reductions.
Exact guest words corroborate the neutral halfword gate for Library and University, native wonder half, UEA 24 test, classifier/global gate, city flag gate, and shared final half reduction.

One exact decoded load/store displacement candidate at 0x82D25330 forms 0x82FFE7C8 from lis 0x8300 and displacement -0x1838. It compares the signed word with 2 and skips the following receiver slot +0x80 call when the word is at least 2; the indirect target and policy meaning are unresolved.

Selected exact words establish the literal-one word-shift mask used by the item-specific tests before common Wonder scaling. Joined to initialized record IDs, the resulting masks alias Wonder 229 to Barracks and Wonder 233 to Library; the existing later predicate also matches 233 for the conditional three-quarter subtraction. Eligibility and runtime execution are separate.

The accepted scenario schema maps QUARTERPRICELIB to slot 23, and the accepted application copy transfers 64 halfwords to active base 0x830E8FD0. This places the selected slot at base plus 46, 0x830E8FFE, conditional on that application path. The cost helper tests the unsigned halfword for nonzero. Actual selection, retained live value, other writers and full gameplay policy remain unproved.

scalarQuery.qualification: The query emits matching instructions only when Ghidra assigns them to a function; it does not cover functionless or undecoded code.

candidateFunction.result: 0x82D2532C forms 0x83000000 with lis; the load at 0x82D25330 uses -0x1838, producing effective address 0x82FFE7C8. The signed compare with 2 at 0x82D25334 branches to 0x82D2536C when the value is at least 2. If below 2, the code also loads a pointer from 0x82FFD624 and tests its +0xC word for zero before dispatching receiver slot +0x80 at 0x82D25368.

relatedGlobalReaderSearch.stopBoundary: This proves one additional static reader and its local branch only. The global's writer, policy meaning, runtime value, indirect call target, and relation to the final cost reduction remain unresolved.

currentEvidence.qualification: Ghidra's configured cost-helper function listing truncates after the save-register thunk, so current-image raw words, not its decompilation, support the interior cost addresses. The separate 0x82FFE7C8 reader is a decoded function body, but this follow-up searches only the exact signed/unsigned displacement in the listed load/store mnemonics and only function-owned decoded instructions. The base and local branch are confirmed; the global's meaning, writer, indirect target, and runtime value remain unresolved. No runtime probe was performed.

guards: Do not treat UEA 21 as a retail active bonus or assign it a player-facing name from this dormant branch.
Do not name neutral global words, halfword array, or city +0x3C bit without separate producer and consumer evidence.
Do not infer the policy meaning of 0x82FFE7C8 from its separate signed comparison or indirect call gate.
Do not apply percentage reductions to original factors when the branch acts on the already modified cost.
Do not treat the helper's ID ranges as initialized-definition validation or claim every caller uses identical final cost.
Do not infer gameplay-effect execution, UI parity, AI parity, production completion, or runtime behavior from cost arithmetic.

Do not infer admitted production from a mask alias: on the accepted known-vtable route, Wonder 229 requires dynamic bit-two admission and its complete outer gate; Wonder 233 is outside the ordinary production menu and is rejected by that city-update gate. Alternate paths and a universal invalid-ID rule remain unproved.

With a stable supported retail civilization row, table and player, German UEA 19 and Roman UEA 24 cannot coactivate for Wonder 229; Greek or Chinese UEA 20 and Roman UEA 24 likewise cannot coactivate for Wonder 233. Preserve cumulative-era and excluded-player rules. Effective bonus overrides or changing sampled state are different premises, and actual joint activation remains unobserved.
conclusion: Beyond the accepted Barracks, Library, Courthouse, and UEA 24 branches, the exact cost helper contains a Cathedral UEA-21 half reduction, neutral-gated University half and Factory one-third reductions, a neutral-gated Library/University three-quarter reduction, and separate final half reductions for the wonder and building paths. A separate defined function reads the 0x82FFE7C8 word and uses a signed less-than-two comparison to gate an indirect slot +0x80 call; it does not establish that global's policy meaning or producer. The formulas and reader are static; activation, global meanings, valid-ID enforcement, and runtime parity remain unresolved. Within the initialized domains, Wonder 229 also selects the Barracks mask and Wonder 233 selects the Library mask, including the later conditional three-quarter subtraction. These are static helper aliases subject to the eligibility and retail-composition guards above. The accepted scenario copy supplies a conditional QUARTERPRICELIB input to that shared gate without proving its retained runtime value.
